ios.desc:
Access the world's knowledge offline with Kiwix! Download free educational content once and browse it anytime, anywhere - no internet connection needed.
Kiwix uses advanced compression technology to store vast amounts of content whilst taking minimal space on your device. Whether you're traveling, have limited internet access, or simply want to save on data costs, Kiwix puts reliable information at your fingertips.

Need help? Our team is available at info@kiwix.org should you need any clarifications or support.

Support us! Kiwix is a non-profit and displays no ads nor collects any data. Feel free to donate here: https://donate.kiwix.org OR use Apple Pay for donations in the app.

quotes.text:
The app itself is also called Kiwix: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kiwix/id997079563

The latest full snapshot (including low res images) is here and clocks in around 102gb: https://dumps.wikimedia.org/kiwix/zim/wikipedia/wikipedia_en_all_maxi_2023-08.zim

I live on an RV and end up working off of solar power far from cell service, so when I run out of power for Starlink there's no internet and Kiwix is super handy for relevant reading material.
quotes.story_title: Apple finally put USB-C in new iPhone, but limited to 23-year-old USB 2.0 speeds
